indications: Purulent or mucopurulent urethral discharge in men
Endocervical yellow discharge or friability in women
partnerManagement: All sexual partners within the last 60 days must be treated simultaneously.
followUpSchedule: Return on Day 7. If symptoms persist, reassess and refer for lab culture.
staffOnlyRegimen: Tab Azithromycin 1g orally single dose + Inj Ceftriaxone 250mg/500mg IM single dose (or Tab Cefixime 400mg)
publicEducationNotes: Single-visit dual therapy curing both Gonorrhea and Chlamydia. Available free at all Suraksha Clinics.

indications: Curdy white thick cottage-cheese discharge with intense itching (Candidiasis)
Homogeneous grayish discharge with fishy odor (Bacterial Vaginosis)
partnerManagement: Treat partner for Trichomoniasis; partner treatment not required for uncomplicated Candidiasis.
followUpSchedule: Check on Day 7 to ensure symptoms have cleared.
staffOnlyRegimen: Tab Secnidazole 2g single dose (or Tab Metronidazole 400mg BD x 7 days) + Cap Fluconazole 150mg single dose
publicEducationNotes: Provides combined antifungal and antiprotozoal coverage.

indications: Multiple painful, non-vesicular sores with ragged undermined edges (Chancroid)
partnerManagement: Treat all partners within the last 90 days with standard syphilis therapy.
followUpSchedule: Mandatory follow-up on Day 7. Ulcers should show re-epithelialization.
staffOnlyRegimen: Inj Benzathine Penicillin G 2.4 MU IM (after test dose) + Tab Azithromycin 1g orally single dose
publicEducationNotes: Curative injectable penicillin and oral antibiotic combination.

indications: Genital ulcer disease in patients with confirmed penicillin allergy
partnerManagement: Treat partner with alternative oral regimen.
staffOnlyRegimen: Tab Doxycycline 100mg BD for 14 days + Tab Azithromycin 1g orally single dose
publicEducationNotes: Oral alternative regimen for penicillin-allergic individuals.

indications: Shallow painful erosions with burning sensation
partnerManagement: Counselling on transmission during asymptomatic shedding; treat if partner has active lesions.
followUpSchedule: Return on Day 7 if lesions do not heal.
staffOnlyRegimen: Tab Acyclovir 400mg TDS for 7 days (or 200mg 5 times daily for 7 days)
publicEducationNotes: Antiviral medication that relieves pain and speeds viral ulcer healing.

syndrome: Lower Abdominal Pain (Pelvic Inflammatory Disease / PID)
indications: Bilateral lower abdominal pain in women
partnerManagement: Treat male partners for urethral infection.
followUpSchedule: Re-evaluate within 72 hours. If no improvement, hospitalize for parenteral therapy.
staffOnlyRegimen: Tab Cefixime 400mg single dose + Tab Metronidazole 400mg BD x 14 days + Tab Doxycycline 100mg BD x 14 days
publicEducationNotes: Broad-spectrum coverage preventing tubal scarring and infertility.

indications: Painful fluctuant groin lymph node swelling (Bubo)
followUpSchedule: Return on Day 7 and Day 14. Never incise and drain fluctuant bubo (aspirate if tense).
staffOnlyRegimen: Tab Doxycycline 100mg BD for 21 days + Tab Azithromycin 1g single dose
publicEducationNotes: Extended antibiotic therapy for lymphatic STI infections.
